rationale: The agent misinterpreted the task as a generic `cargo update` and spent the entire trajectory pinning transitive dependencies to avoid MSRV/edition2024 errors, without ever identifying or applying the actual dependency upgrades required by the task (e.g., smoltcp 0.10→0.11, image 0.24→0.25, windows 0.52→0.56, env_logger 0.10→0.11, nix 0.27→0.28, data-encoding 2.5→2.6). The verifier failure shows a compilation error in src/network/tests.rs because the agent never made the necessary source-code changes to adapt to the upgraded smoltcp API. The candidate patch only modifies Cargo.lock with version pins, not the required Cargo.toml bumps or source fixes.
